scenario: I am a construction worker. I and my crew are standing on some scaffolding, working on a skyscraper. Suddenly, the scaffolding collapses partially. I and several others are hanging on to a dangling crossbar, but it cannot hold the weight of all of me. The worker next to me slips off the crossbar and catches himself on another portion of the scaffolding. The entire structure is about to give way. If I pull out a latch that will detach the section of scaffolding with my co-worker on it, this will remove just enough weight that the rest of us can make it to safety before the scaffolding collapses entirely. This will kill him but save me and the other five coworkers.
choice: I decide to remove weight by pulling out the latch so your co-worker falls off the crossbar
entities: i,1 coworker on the section of scaffolding that would be detached
outcomes: The co-worker on the detached section falls from the scaffolding.
The co-worker on the detached section dies.
The remaining scaffolding supports less weight.
The five surviving coworkers experience immediate emotional distress.
